nodes.label: Per-Sample ΔSyncD by Audio Gain Level
nodes.description: Heatmap showing per-sample ΔSyncD across gain levels (-10dB to +10dB) for samples 3, 6, 8, 10, 12. Higher gain consistently improves SyncD; attenuation degrades it severely. Sample 8 shows extreme sensitivity (ΔSyncD +0.92 at -10dB to -0.68 at +10dB).

metadata.finding: Higher audio gain generally improves lip-sync (lower ΔSyncD); effect varies across samples; standardizing audio amplitude recommended as preprocessing
